summary: HomeStream is a TypeScript ESM pnpm monorepo for LAN media playback. Fastify 5 on Node 24 owns SQLite, TMDB metadata, gateway discovery, NVENC transcoding, proxy caching, TorBox tracking and health. React 19/Vite implements Home, search, movie/show details and Settings with TanStack Query, SSE download updates and local device identity; Player and dashboard tabs are placeholders. Electron 45 package is a support-module skeleton with no window/tray/supervisor/preload. Shared Zod contracts, analytics, identity, flags and sanitization live in packages/shared.
architecture: index.ts loads config/logging, builds services, recovers encoder orphans, starts loopback proxy then LAN listener, health/download workers and mDNS. Playback resolves ranked sources, probes through proxy, decides output from capabilities, starts ffmpeg and serves HLS. No usable cached source can produce 202 download tracking. Browser lazy routes use schema-validating API client and defer device registration, SSE and optional telemetry until content and idle time. Browser Play links reach an unimplemented player.
patterns: Strict NodeNext TS with .js specifiers and type-only imports. Thin routes validate shared Zod schemas; AppError returns redacted error envelopes with hints. Pure rules have offline unit tests; Fastify inject integration tests use fakes. GPU/live tiers are opt-in. Resource ownership and shutdown are explicit. Hot paths must not regress. Telemetry is optional and allowlisted. No accounts; devices are not authentication; LAN only; always re-encode video; clients send streamId auto.
